author: 5kO0
content:
Root cause: MstNode::detect_layer returned None for nodes containing only tree children (no leaves), causing get_layer() to fall back to 0. This corrupted the layer of intermediate parents built by insert_into_child for keys whose layer is several levels below the current root, producing structurally-illegal trees (a layer-0 node holding a layer-1 subtree) and breaking insertion-order independence.

Fix in proto-blue-repo/src/mst/node.rs:
1. detect_layer: when no leaves are present, infer layer from first tree child (parent_layer = child_layer + 1)
2. insert_into_child: explicitly preserve self.get_layer() on the returned node instead of relying on detect_layer

Verification:
- mst::node::tests::layer_invariant_holds_after_mixed_insertions (new) — asserts every Tree child sits at parent_layer - 1
- mst::node::tests::order_independence_bisect (new) — iterates 1..=50 keys forward vs reverse, every prefix's CIDs match
- differential_mst_root_cid_multi_leaf (un-#[ignore]'d) — passes against @atproto/repo TS reference for all 5 multi-leaf fixtures (two_keys, dense_small, tid_shape, fifty_keys, mixed_collections)
- differential_mst_root_cid_insertion_order_independent (un-#[ignore]'d) — passes against TS for the 6-leaf scrambled fixture

Test counts: 125 lib + 13 integration + 13 property + 2 doctests passing; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean for proto-blue-repo.
